Build a schema from a data frame

Source: R/schema.R
cs_schema.Rd

Infers a Frictionless Table Schema v2 from a data frame, honoring factors (ordered and unordered), haven::labelled vectors, Date, POSIXct, integer-versus-double, logical, and character columns. Per-field overrides and table-level keys may be supplied.

Usage

cs_schema(
  df,
  overrides = NULL,
  primary_key = NULL,
  foreign_keys = NULL,
  fields_match = NULL,
  enc = "utf-8",
  dialect = "rfc4180"
)

is_cs_schema(x)

Arguments

df

A data frame.

overrides

Named list; each name is a column and each value a list of Frictionless field properties to merge over the inferred field (for example list(ein = list(constraints = list(pattern = "^[0-9]{9}$", unique = TRUE)))).

primary_key

Character vector of field names forming the primary key.

foreign_keys

List of foreign keys, each list(fields =, reference = list(resource =, fields =)).

fields_match

Frictionless fieldsMatch mode, or NULL.

enc

Intended encoding of the data columns, recorded for diagnosis.

dialect

CSV dialect name recorded in packet 0.

x

An object to test with is_cs_schema().

Value

An object of class cs_schema.

Examples

cs_schema(data.frame(id = 1:3, grp = factor(c("a", "b", "a"))))
#> <cs_schema> 2 fields (3 rows) 
#>   id                   integer   
#>   grp                  string    [2 levels]
#>   hash: 8e03eb4ab6fb
